items.previewSummary: Dhaka, Nov 9 (IANS) As Bangladesh grapples with escalating violence and a deteriorating law-and-order situation, at least eight buses have been set ablaze and more than 50 crude bomb explosions rocked different locations across Dhaka over the past few days, according to a local media report.

items.previewSummary: As artificial intelligence evolves, it accelerates business analysis, posing new challenges for decision-makers. The rapid generation of insights can overwhelm leaders, creating strategic risks, as highlighted by McKinsey. Their findings stress that while analysis speeds up, human judgment remains vital for decision-making. To thrive, organizations must enhance their capacity for human oversight, ensuring a balance between AI advantages and critical executive judgment in strategic operations.

items.title: কালো জলের পদ্ম
items.summary: সেদিন মাঝরাতে মন্টুর ডিঙিনৌকায় যখন গিয়ে বসলাম, চারপাশটা এক নিরেট কালো চাদরে ঢাকা। ভৈরবের ঘোলাটে জল ছলাৎ ছলাৎ শব্দে নৌকার গায়ে আছড়ে পড়ছে। দূরে বাঁশবাগান থেকে রাতজাগা পাখির ডাক ভেসে আসছে। মন্টু নিঃশব্দে লগি ঠেলছে। কালুডোম ঘাটের কাছাকাছি পৌঁছাতেই আকাশ কালো করে মেঘ জমে উঠল। শ্রাবণের এই এক বদভ্যাস, যখন-তখন প্রলয় বাধিয়ে দেয়।

items.previewSummary: The West Indies declared their second innings at 398 for six on the fifth morning of the second Test in Sylhet, setting Bangladesh a target of 369 runs to win. Bangladesh had taken a 30-run lead in the first innings after scoring 386 in reply to the West Indies’ 356. The visitors therefore finished 368 runs ahead overall, leaving Bangladesh needing 369 to win the match.

items.previewSummary: Doha, November 08 (QNA) - The Communications Regulatory Authority (CRA) is showcasing the outcome of advanced technology trials at the State of Qatar Pavilion during MWC26 Doha, held at the Doha Exhibition and Convention Center (DECC) from November 8 to 10, 2026. The trials demonstrate the potential of advanced mobile technologies to deliver higher data speeds, greater network capacity and enhanced network performance, representing an important step in Qatar's technology evolution paving the way towards the IMT-2030/6G era. CRA is leading the initiative in collaboration with Ooredoo Qatar and Vodafone Qatar, with Huawei participating as the technology partner.

items.previewTitle: West Indies focused on piling lead, not setting a target: Hodge
items.previewSummary: West Indies batter Kavem Hodge said his team will keep extending their lead rather than set a fixed target in the second Test against Bangladesh in Sylhet. After Day 4, West Indies reached 345-3, leading by 315 runs. Hodge was unbeaten on 140, saying his century was satisfying after a quiet first Test. He credited Bangladesh’s Towhid Hridoy’s 242 not out as inspiration and named spin as potentially decisive on the final day.

items.summary: West Indies take 315-run lead, Bangladesh face record chase Prothom Alo English
items.previewTitle: West Indies take 315-run lead, Bangladesh face record chase
items.previewSummary: West Indies tightened their grip on the Sylhet Test on day four, reaching 345 for three and leading Bangladesh by 315 runs. Kavem Hodge remained unbeaten on 140 for his third Test century, while Kevin Wickham made two half-centuries on debut. Bangladesh now face a daunting final-innings chase and must surpass their record successful Test chase of 215, set against West Indies in 2009, to win.

items.previewTitle: Creating a technological foundation for artificial intelligence in Vietnam.
items.previewSummary: Resolution No. 57-NQ/TW of the Politburo identifies the development of science, technology, innovation, and digital transformation as top priority breakthroughs. Artificial intelligence (AI) is identified as a strategic technology, opening up numerous application opportunities across various industries and fields. To effectively exploit this potential, Vietnam needs to develop research capabilities, master data, build computing infrastructure, and construct AI models suitable for domestic needs.

items.previewSummary: On the morning of November 7, 2026, at the 31/10 Hall, Thai Nguyen University of Education, in collaboration with the Department of Higher Education (Ministry of Education and Training) and RMIT University Vietnam, successfully organized Session 6 and the Closing Ceremony of the "Enhancing Artificial Intelligence (AI) Application Capacity for Ethnic Minority Learners in 2026" program series. The program was implemented using a hybrid format (in-person and online), connecting and attracting enthusiastic participation from thousands of students from 11 higher education institutions nationwide.

items.previewTitle: Injury blow for Bangladesh! Shadman Islam ruled out of South Africa series after Sylhet Test setback
items.previewSummary: Bangladesh have suffered a major setback ahead of their upcoming Test tour of South Africa, with opener Shadman Islam ruled out after sustaining an ankle injury during the ongoing second Test against West Indies in Sylhet. The injury, which could involve both a tear and a fracture, has ruled the left-hander out of the two-match series, forcing the team management to look for an alternative at the top of the order.

items.previewTitle: Sylhet Test: Taijul, Miraz strike, but West Indies take 98-run lead
items.previewSummary: West Indies scored 121 runs in 30 overs and lost two wickets in the first session of the fourth day of the Sylhet Test, extending their lead over Bangladesh to 98 runs. At lunch, West Indies were 128 for 2 in their second innings. Bangladesh’s spinners took both wickets, with Taijul Islam dismissing Joshua Da Silva for 36 and Mehidy Hasan Miraz removing half-centurion Brandon King for 61.

items.previewTitle: AI to boost industrial robotics growth, but manufacturers may benefit less than customers: S&P Global
items.previewSummary: Artificial intelligence is anticipated to significantly enhance the long-term prospects of industrial robotics and automation. Manufacturers may experience reduced benefits compared to their customers, as equipment utilization increases. Global industrial robot installations have increased markedly, driven by labour shortages and productivity needs. AI improvements are projected to further expand automation capabilities before achieving full autonomy. However, the overall impact on manufacturers' profits remains uncertain due to competitive market dynamics.

items.previewSummary: According to a recent Jefferies report, global investment in artificial intelligence appears to be facing a mid-cycle correction. Although US tech giants have ramped up their capital spending, there are growing concerns regarding both financing and profitability. This situation may adversely impact US economic growth. Investors are advised to explore opportunities outside the AI realm, especially in healthcare and biotechnology sectors.

items.previewTitle: Hridoy, Mushfiqur steady Bangladesh after early wickets
items.previewSummary: Bangladesh reached 88 for 3 in 40 overs at the close of the second day of the Sylhet Test on Friday, trailing West Indies by 268 runs in the first innings. After losing three wickets for 51 runs, Bangladesh were steadied by Towhid Hridoy and Mushfiqur Rahim. The pair added 37 runs for the fourth wicket before stumps. Hridoy was unbeaten on 29, while Mushfiqur was on 19.

items.summary: লেখক ও পরিচালক ২০০৪ সালে বসে এই বিষয় নিয়ে ভেবেছেন। মুক্তিযুদ্ধের সময় এ ধরনের প্রশ্ন উঠত বলেই তাঁরা ভেবেছেন। নারীকে অত্যাচারিত হয়ে পুরুষশাসিত সমাজের দাঁড় করানো এই অগ্নিপরীক্ষার ভেতর দিয়ে যেতে হয়েছে যুগের পর যুগ। নারীকে বিশ্বাসযোগ্যতা অর্জন করতে হয়েছে চিরাচরিত সমাজের বানানো মাপকাঠিতেই, তাতে ব্যক্তিত্বের মানহানি ঘটেছে। তাতে ব্যক্তিত্বের মান বারবার লাঞ্ছিত হয়েছে।

items.previewSummary: The US federal government is preparing to reveal the regulations applicable to domestic AI labs. Pentagon Chief Technology Officer Emil Michael announced that details will be shared in a couple of weeks. The Super Intelligence Task Force was established to regulate AI policy following concerns about industry practices. Michael emphasized the importance of creating a regulatory framework that builds public confidence.

items.previewTitle: Government: There are challenges, but the people’s govt will not be defeated
items.previewSummary: The article argues that Sheikh Hasina’s fall is only one victory; Bangladesh faces a long struggle to rebuild collapsed institutions and democratic governance. The current government has made uneven progress in eight months amid economic and energy crises inherited from Awami rule and worsened globally. It cites expanded welfare and energy measures, improved law and order, and some accountability, while acknowledging public frustration. It stresses that laws must be judged by application, and democratic governments must tolerate criticism and correct mistakes.

items.summary: ২০২২ সালের ৩১ ডিসেম্বর প্রথম আলো বন্ধুসভার ‘এসো মিলি জলধারা’ নৌবিহারে ময়মনসিংহ থেকে চাঁদপুর যাওয়ার সেই যাত্রা আজও মনে দাগ কেটে আছে। সেই স্মৃতির ধারাবাহিকতায় প্রথম আলো বন্ধুসভার ২৮তম প্রতিষ্ঠাবার্ষিকী উপলক্ষে আবারও আয়োজনের পরিকল্পনা করা হয়েছে ‘এসো মিলি জলধারা ২.০’। বন্ধুত্ব, অভিজ্ঞতা বিনিময় ও সাংগঠনিক বন্ধন আরও দৃঢ় করার এক মিলনমেলা।

items.summary: Emerging applications of machine learning and AI for predictive modeling in precision medicine Nature
items.previewTitle: Emerging applications of machine learning and AI for predictive modeling in precision medicine - npj Digital Medicine
items.previewSummary: Pure data-driven artificial intelligence (AI) is insufficient for clinical adoption. This editorial summarizes 31 papers showing that precision medicine requires integrating structural domain knowledge before model training. We identify three necessary transitions: anchoring algorithms in biological laws for mechanistic interpretability; designing collaborative, human-centered clinical interfaces; and scaling equitable, population-level interventions. These shifts advance medical AI from technical novelty toward trustworthy, clinically grounded, and ethically deployed foundational science.

items.title: এক মাঠে কারও শৈশব, কারও বেঁচে থাকার লড়াই
items.summary: মাঠের পাশে একটি ছেলে বসে আছে। তার হাতে হাওয়াই মিঠাইয়ের গুচ্ছ। মাঠের ভেতরে সমবয়সী শিশুরা খেলছে, ছুটছে, হাসছে। আর ছেলেটি বসে বসে তাদের খেলা দেখছে। তার চোখের সামনে একটা মাঠ, কিছু শিশু আর একটুকরা শৈশব; যে শৈশবের অংশ হওয়ার ইচ্ছা হয়তো তারও আছে, কিন্তু সেই ইচ্ছার চেয়েও বড় হয়ে দাঁড়িয়েছে জীবিকার তাগিদ। দৃশ্যটি দেখে কিছুক্ষণের জন্য থমকে দাঁড়ালাম। তারপর ক্যামেরাটি হাতে তুলে ছেলেটির কয়েকটি ছবি নিলাম।

items.previewTitle: A hotter world could have cleaner air, but deadlier heatwaves
items.previewSummary: Using the extreme heat conditions of 2018–2019, researchers modelled how global warming of 2°C and 2.75°C could affect heatwaves, air pollution and associated mortality across six world regions. The simulations showed increased heatwave-related deaths in every region, particularly South America, while ozone and fine particulate pollution declined in many areas under the higher warming scenario, highlighting contrasting health risks under fixed present-day conditions.

items.summary: মানবিক ও জীবনঘনিষ্ঠ বই নিয়ে পাঠচক্রের আসর করে জাহাঙ্গীরনগর বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় বন্ধুসভা। ১২ অক্টোবর বিকেলে বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের ছাত্র-শিক্ষক কেন্দ্রের (টিএসসি) ১০ নম্বর কক্ষে এ আসর অনুষ্ঠিত হয়। বইভিত্তিক সামাজিক সংগঠন ‘গ্রন্থআশ্রম’-এর সহযোগিতায় পাঠচক্রে মূল আলোচক হিসেবে বক্তব্য উপস্থাপন করেন জাবি বন্ধুসভার মুক্তিযুদ্ধ ও গবেষণা সম্পাদক মাহফুজা ইসলাম।

items.previewSummary: Next Technology Holding, the 18th-largest public corporate bitcoin holder, authorized the sale or pledging of its 5,833 BTC following Binance's major security breach. Although none of its bitcoin was held at Binance, the incident prompted the company to reassess risks related to exchange vulnerabilities, cyberattacks, and future quantum computing threats. The board gave the CEO authority over transaction timing and volume but has not disclosed any completed sales. This move reflects growing caution among corporate bitcoin holders about security and liquidity risks in the crypto market.

items.previewSummary: In a groundbreaking achievement, Google has successfully implemented an artificial intelligence model aboard a prototype satellite, marking a significant milestone for Project Suncatcher. Once launched, the satellite underwent initial tests where it powered its TPU and creatively generated a haiku about the cosmos. Future objectives involve challenging the satellite's resilience through various thermal and radiation tests, pushing the boundaries of AI in space exploration.

Bangladesh, 79-6 in their second innings, led by 106 runs when Day 3 ended, with Nayeem and Jaker Ali unbeaten on 18. Nayeem, who took 4-33, said batting as long as possible and reaching 200 would be valuable on a turning pitch. He also noted the top order could have batted better and welcomed captain Najmul Hossain Shanto’s advice.
